hypothesis: For the frozen B sleeve, exiting at T+1 open after the stock's current industry-relative 20-day return turns negative while its 5-session change is also negative will reduce drawdown / weak-market losses without changing entry ranks, position count, stop loss, holding cap, or portfolio risk budget.

rule.signal_day: At T close, ext_alt_hs300_stock_rel_industry_20d < 0 AND current relative strength minus its value five trading sessions earlier < 0.
rule.execution: Use the existing T+1 open signal exit; maintain existing -20% stop and 20 trading-session max hold.
rule.entry: Unchanged R101 B scoring, filters, and entry time.
rule.industry_data: Existing timeseries factor is backfilled with current THS industry classifications, not PIT; this is explicitly a non-PIT structural test.

comparison: Frozen R359 v2 portfolio and R344 standalone A/B/C sleeve caches; only B changes. Portfolio uses the same monthly risk-parity, 10% C cap, 15% vol target and gold defensive ballast.

performance_gates.G1_2x_annual_not_below_R359_by_more_than: candidate 2x annualized >= R359 v2 2x annualized - 1 percentage point.
performance_gates.G6_minimum_4_of_6_fresh_starts_positive: Six fixed phase starts including 2022-05-05, at least four positive.
performance_gates.G8_no_leverage: All targets nonnegative and <= 100%; no borrowing.

diagnostics: Standalone B sleeve 2x/5x performance, MDD, turnover, trade count, signal count, early exits, stop-loss and max-hold counts.
Year-by-year returns, 6 fixed starts, 2x and 5x costs, 5x top1/top3/top5 net contribution, industry concentration.
No threshold/window/weight sweep. No selection or threshold changes after returns are observed.
known_limits: Current industry snapshot backfill; not PIT industry data.
HS300 membership for historical backtests uses daily membership snapshots in research runner; same caveat as R344/R359.
The periods overlap earlier research; this is a hypothesis test, not independent out-of-sample evidence.
Passing gates would only justify a further independent robustness/forward paper study, not production enablement.
decision: If preflight fails, record without reading returns. If preflight passes, run exactly the fixed 2x/5x comparison; retain research-only regardless of gates, with selected=null and no paper target/orders/production write.
